On Wed, Jan 10, 2024 at 11:36 AM Josh Blumenfeld < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi USAID Team,

Many thanks,
Josh
On Tue, Jan 9, 2024 at 12:16 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Team Power / USAID
Happy New Year; I hope this note finds you all well. I'm reaching out to see if the Administrator may be available to
meet with YouTube's CEO, Neal Mohan, at Davos (January 16, 17, or18). Neal would be very interested in discussing a
range of issues of mutual interest including access information, independent media, and economic empowerment, as
well as any issues top of mind for the Administrator.
We know the Administrator's schedule is extremely packed, but wanted to reach out with the request. Please let me
know if you have any questions or need any additional information.
Many thanks!
Josh
